reason: Genuine port. A named group in the line comment's own regex (`^//+(?<TEXT>.*)$`) anchors the finding after the leading slashes, where TSLint's status.start is, so every finding matches start and end (28/28 across 6 fixtures).

evidence.why: `// This comment has a capital...`: capture.TEXT starts at 5:27 with TSLint, not at the `//` (5:25)
`////foo`: `//+` consumes all four slashes, so the finding starts at 10:9
